Name: Heavy Duty Tools - Chainsaw and Flamethrower
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Welcome to industrialization! An age of mass destruction and lots of fire. Maru's tinkering has ushered in a new age of machines.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

• 2 new late game tools designed to be stronger than the iridium axe.
﻿ ﻿﻿The Chainsaw
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Uses Gas to run
﻿ ﻿The Flamethrower
      ﻿ ﻿- Uses Napalm as fuel
﻿ ﻿      - Creates a new type of fertilizer - Ash

Recipes / how to unlock
[Spoiler]
Chainsaw - Complete Maru's quest line. Unlocked after reaching 8 hearts with Maru and Foraging level 8
Gas - Put 20 sap and 1 coal into a furnace

Flamethrower - Reach the Ginger island volcano to unlock Maru's quest line
Napalm - Put 20 slime into an oil maker
[/Spoiler]

Added in v.1.1 If you have GMCM Options (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505) you can customize the flame color!



[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.
[*]Compatible with most recolor mods
[*]Should be compatible with multiplayer - untested
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and destroy the forest.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Note: If you destroy trees with the flamethrower, you will *NOT* get wood. This is intended.
[*]If you use non-default farmer bodies your farmer may become faceless and naked while using this. I am investigating source.
[/list]
